purpose: Declared source relations between the cradle's executable frontend tests and the #65 obligation field (docs/experience/campaign.json source_modules). standing: declared relations, not performed evidence; a binding asserts what a test CAN prove, the receipt records what it DID prove on its recorded cut
evidence_rule: #201 grade law: a passed deterministic walk earns D (deterministic) at most, or C (cross-product conformance) only when its receipt grade is A/B (native/real-kernel bridge). No automation earns P (real provider/harness), M (physical/material) or H (human UX/Recognition); those stay unproved here and belong to their owning proving rounds.
